entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:1
segments: ¶Dead flies make the oil of the perfumer give out an evil smell; more valued is a little wisdom than the great glory of the foolish.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:2
segments: The heart of the wise man goes in the right direction; but the heart of a foolish man in the wrong.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:3
segments: And when the foolish man is walking in the way, he has no sense and lets everyone see that he is foolish.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:4
segments: ¶If the wrath of the ruler is against you, keep in your place; in him who keeps quiet even great sins may be overlooked.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:5
segments: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, like an error which comes by chance from a ruler:

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:6
segments: The foolish are placed in high positions, but men of wealth are kept low.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:7
segments: I have seen servants on horses, and rulers walking on the earth as servants.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:8
segments: He who makes a hole for others will himself go into it, and for him who makes a hole through a wall the bite of a snake will be a punishment.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:9
segments: He who gets out stones from the earth will be damaged by them, and in the cutting of wood there is danger.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:10
segments: If the iron has no edge, and he does not make it sharp, then he has to put out more strength; but wisdom makes things go well.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:11
segments: If a snake gives a bite before the word of power is said, then there is no longer any use in the word of power.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:12
segments: ¶The words of a wise man's mouth are sweet to all, but the lips of a foolish man are his destruction.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:13
segments: The first words of his mouth are foolish, and the end of his talk is evil crime.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:14
segments: The foolish are full of words; man has no knowledge of what will be; and who is able to say what will be after him?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:15
segments: The work of the foolish will be a weariness to him, because he has no knowledge of the way to the town.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:16
segments: ¶Unhappy is the land whose king is a boy, and whose rulers are feasting in the morning.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:17
segments: Happy is the land whose ruler is of noble birth, and whose chiefs take food at the right time, for strength and not for feasting.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:18
segments: When no work is done the roof goes in, and when the hands do nothing water comes into the house.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:19
segments: A feast is for laughing, and wine makes glad the heart; but by the one and the other money is wasted.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:20
segments: Say not a curse against the king, even in your thoughts; and even secretly say not a curse against the man of wealth; because a bird of the air will take the voice, and that which has wings will give news of it.
